senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. הָדַף) [to drive, scatter,] (neut. verb) to spread (of odors).
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, beg. <he>היה ריחו נוֹדֵף</he> its perfume went forth.

<cite ref="Berakhot 51a">Ber. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שאכל שום וריחו נודף</he> … <he>נודף יותר</he> Ms. M., shall he who has eaten garlic so that his breath smells, eat again, that his breath may smell still more?, i.e. having done one wrong, shall one do another wrong?; a. fr.
